canonical_scalar_matching.scope: Leading massless-source, large-mediator one-loop matching at mu=M, including scalar canonical normalization. All coefficients must be divided by 16*pi^2. Finite light masses and heavy-quark matching are outside this approximation.

Callan_Symanzik.scope: One-loop Callan-Symanzik identity for the full minimal scalar potential, with gauge/Yukawa contributions and off-diagonal scalar anomalous dimensions.

Yukawa_tensor_certificate.normalization: 16*pi^2 beta coefficients; gY uses SM hypercharge, not GUT normalization
Yukawa_tensor_certificate.scope: Complete one-loop dimensionless Yukawa running for the specified renormalizable action; lepton Yukawas set zero.

direct_beta_certificate.scope: One-loop full dimensionless running of the specified unbroken minimal action; no lepton Yukawas. Not yet a threshold-matched physical CKM flow.

complete_soft_running.scope: One-loop MS-bar running above heavy thresholds in the renormalizable Gaussian soft-current class, with zero lepton Yukawas. Tree matching of running parameters is recorded, not a physical CKM RG prediction or full finite threshold matching.

conclusion: Exact loop algebra, complete specified one-loop running and new finite-mass/quality/vacuum tests constrain the next mechanism. Golden CKM and Sommerfeld coupling remain unpredicted.

coordinate_subalgebra_census.scope: Complete census of coordinate subspaces in the certified nine-operator adjoint-pair algebra; not all rotated subspaces or nonlinear RG-invariant varieties.

dimension_eight_quality_operator.CP_consistency: O4(CP fields)=-O4(fields), hence (i O4)(CP fields)=(i O4(fields))*
dimension_eight_quality_operator.allowed_operator: i c O4(Au,Ad) bar(Q_L) H d_R/Lambda^4 + h.c.; dimension eight
dimension_eight_quality_operator.scope: One explicit allowed higher Yukawa operator on this minimal field content. Cutoffs in declared model units; no complete higher-operator census or derived cutoff.

finite_current_running.Yukawa_addition: +12 a_u^2 g_uR, with source adjoint Yukawa a_u and three colors
finite_current_running.normalization: All beta coefficients multiplied by 16*pi^2; Gaussian soft-current UV class.
finite_current_running.scalar_current_beta: beta(g_uR)=(16 lambda_u+k_R kappa_u)g_uR+4 lambda_R g_dR; swap u,d for beta(g_dR)

gauge_threshold.scope: One-loop gauge matching of the six electroweak-singlet vectorlike quarks. Gauge normalization remains an input.

heavy_scalar_matching_certificate.general_matching_at_mu_M_16pi2: Delta V2=-Tr(D D^T)/2; Delta V4=-Tr(D H_EFT D^T)/(2 M^2)
heavy_scalar_matching_certificate.scope: Leading one-loop heavy-scalar matching for Gaussian soft mediation with massless light sources and expansion in fields/M; finite source masses, gauge/quark thresholds and higher powers require additional matching.
heavy_scalar_matching_certificate.wavefunction_16pi2: Delta Z_a=2 sum_R g_aR^2 sum_i E_Ri^2/M_R^2 = sum_R dim(R) g_aR^2/(4 M_R^2) times I8

higher_kinetic_response.positive_completion: B=(I+sum real c_i Q_i)^2+epsilon I; epsilon>0, through degree sixteen
higher_kinetic_response.scope: All six finite light masses and the scalar vacuum retained. Heavy masses can change and are reported. Higher kinetic vertices are not covered by the renormalizable one-loop theorem.
higher_kinetic_response.source_covariants: R=A_u^2,T=A_d^2; both neutral under sector Z2 and CP compatible

mass_hierarchy_certificate.assumptions: Canonical triangular D=[[a I,0],[C,M I]], C traceless Hermitian; 0<m1<m2<m3<min(a,M), a,M>0
mass_hierarchy_certificate.scope: Exact finite-mass exclusion of strong light-family hierarchy for a pure traceless source with universal bare Higgs and heavy mass; singlet shifts, nonuniversal masses or kinetic terms change the assumptions.
mass_hierarchy_certificate.trace_condition: Largest |source eigenvalue| equals sum of the other two

one_loop_determinant_expansion.scope: Quadratic expansion of the one-loop-corrected determinant only; omits genuine two-loop self energies and wavefunction matching. Not a complete two-loop strong-CP result.
Quadratic expansion of the one-loop-corrected determinant only; omits genuine two-loop self energies and wavefunction matching. Not a complete two-loop strong-CP result.

quantum_vacuum_feedback.scope: Landau-gauge one-loop gradient at the retained tree vacuum, MS-bar inputs fixed at mu=1. Linear displacement is a validity diagnostic, not a re-minimized quantum vacuum or a complete two-loop phase.

thermal_scope: Leading high-temperature expansion of the minimal action; positive thermal masses indicate asymptotic restoration. Not a resummed transition or cosmological sign-selection calculation.

vacuum_comparison.scope: Numerical stationary points and strict resolved energy comparison establish a lower CP-conserving competitor. The global winner over every branch is not classified.
